content.thinking: The 32768-byte header block now passes. The 32769 test: I replaced "X-P: " with "X-P:  " but the pad lines are now named "X-P000: " — so the replace didn't match. Let me fix that test to add one byte to a pad line differently (e.g., replace "z" with "zz" in the first pad line).

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('t12_bounds.py').read()
src = src.replace('''bigger = text.replace("X-P: ", "X-P:  ", 1)  # add one byte -> 32769''',
                  '''bigger = text.replace("X-P000: z", "X-P000: zz", 1)  # add one byte -> 32769''')
open('t12_bounds.py','w').write(src)
EOF
python3 t12_bounds.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|FAILURES"; python3 t12_bounds.py 2>&1 | tail -8
